guard.forbiddenText: This area is restricted to Sword Brazil curators and administrators.

overview.text: Choose what to edit. Every published change is visible immediately, with date and author.
overview.days: Restrictions for each BAX and BAL day.
overview.metas: Meta teams and reserves per day, BAL free mode and BAI.
overview.rotations: Character rotations (damage dealers), per uniform, with a description and video.

days.title: Day restrictions
days.subtitle: Set each day's restriction. Different criteria are combined with "AND".
days.help: Pick one value per attribute. Leave "Any" to not restrict that attribute. BAI days (3, 10, 17, 24) are not listed.

metas.title: Meta teams
metas.label: Label (e.g. alternative without uniform X)
metas.deleteConfirm: Delete this team? This cannot be undone.
metas.help: Only active agents that meet the day restriction are listed. Marking as primary unmarks the previous one.
metas.boardHint: The whole cycle on one screen: edit, add or delete teams right on the day.
metas.reservesHint: Extra characters for the suggestion when players lack the Meta and Alternative ones. Order used: Meta → Alternatives → reserves.

catalog.title: Agent catalog
catalog.name: Official name
catalog.uploadHint: PNG, WebP or JPEG, up to 2 MB.
catalog.deactivateHint: Deactivating keeps the agent in old teams, marked as unavailable.
catalog.help: Names must match the game. Use kebab-case slugs (e.g. scarlet-witch).
catalog.tooBig: The image must be up to 2 MB.
catalog.badType: Use a PNG, WebP or JPEG image.
catalog.slugAuto: Generated from the name; edit only if needed.
catalog.uniformsHint: Each uniform has its own attributes (gender, side, species and attack): day restrictions are checked against the uniform used. A new uniform starts with the first uniform's attributes.

ctps.title: CTP catalog
ctps.help: Add, edit and delete CTPs. Deactivating hides the CTP from choices and keeps old teams; deleting removes it for good.
ctps.deleteConfirm: Delete {{name}} for good? Meta teams and reserves recommending it will have no CTP. This can't be undone.

bai.title: BAI bosses
bai.subtitle: Single sequence, valid for every week.
bai.name: Name
bai.help: Bosses appear in this order on the BAI page.

users.title: Users and roles
users.lastAdmin: The last administrator cannot be demoted.
users.help: Administrators promote and remove curators. There must always be at least one administrator.

settings.title: Calendar settings
settings.anchor: Start of Day 1 (Brasília date and time)
settings.anchorHelp: A Thursday at 12 PM when a 28-day cycle started.
settings.help: Adjust the anchor if the "Current day" differs from the game.

rotations.subtitle: Each character's rotations: per uniform or for all, free text, with a description and video.
rotations.help: In Metas, mark the team's damage dealer; the character's rotations live here. Players tap the damage dealer's photo to see them.
rotations.editHelp: One rotation per situation or uniform. This order is the order players see.
rotations.sequencePlaceholder: E.g. 1 2c (3dc 4) 6 — or write it your way
rotations.sequenceHint: Free text. If you use the community notation (1–6, c, dc, qc, parentheses), it shows as blocks.
rotations.legendFree: The notation is optional: write it however explains it best.
rotations.descriptionPlaceholder: When to use it, how long each delay is, what to watch for…
rotations.videoHint: YouTube link (video or Shorts; add ?t= to start at the right moment) or a .mp4/.webm file. It plays muted and looped; the video is not stored in the system.
